title: OPIC 실전 코칭 — 해외경험 답변 & Y-component 전략
summary: 메인 포인트는 20초 안에 끝내야 한다 — 무슨 일이 있었는지(what) + 왜 기억에 남는지(why: Y-component)를 함께 말해야 crystal clear해진다
'I don't really remember my first overseas experience, but New York was definitely one of my first.' — 정확히 기억 안 날 때 쓰는 전략
감정(emotion)을 먼저 드러내면 채점관이 더 듣고 싶어진다 — 'I had a terrible experience because I got lost and was very scared'
무서웠다는 표현 업그레이드: scary → intimidating ('He was a little bit intimidating.')
스크립트처럼 안 들리고 'truly from your heart'처럼 들리는 자연스러운 흐름이 고득점 포인트

keyExpressions.en: I had a terrible experience because ...
keyExpressions.note: 감정 + Y-component를 한 문장에 담는 메인 포인트 공식

keyExpressions.en: I don't really remember my first ___, but it was definitely one of my first.
keyExpressions.ko: 첫 ___가 정확히 기억 안 나지만, 분명 처음 중 하나였다
keyExpressions.note: 기억이 불확실할 때 자연스럽게 넘어가는 전략

keyExpressions.en: He was a little bit intimidating.

keyExpressions.note: 민감한 발언 전 완충 표현 — 채점관 집중도 올라감

keyExpressions.en: Make sure your main point is crystal clear.
keyExpressions.ko: 메인 포인트를 완전히 명확하게 해야 한다

keyExpressions.note: 스크립트처럼 안 들리는 자연스러운 답변의 칭찬 표현

keyExpressions.en: I got lost and I was very scared.
keyExpressions.note: Y-component 예시 — 왜 terrible했는지 구체적 이유 제시

cards.back: I had a terrible experience because I got lost and I was very scared.
cards.example: What + Why in one sentence → crystal clear main point under 20 seconds

cards.front: 첫 해외경험이 정확히 기억 안 날 때
cards.back: I don't really remember my first overseas experience, but New York was definitely one of my first.
cards.example: 뒤에 덧붙여도 OK: '...but it was definitely one of my first.'

cards.back: He was a little bit intimidating.
cards.example: A police officer is intimidating because they seem powerful.
Please don't get me wrong, I'm not trying to be racist, but he was a really big guy and a little bit intimidating.
I took the wrong subway line and I got lost in Harlem.
After about 15 minutes, I heard something weird. Someone was looking at me.

cards.front: 덕분에 집에 안전하게 갈 수 있었다
cards.back: They helped me get home safe.
cards.example: I explained my situation and those people helped me get home safe.

cards.back: You're essentially killing two birds with one stone.
cards.example: Mentioning emotion and Y-component in your main point — you're killing two birds with one stone.
